name: Discogenic Low Back Pain
definition: Axial low-back pain suspected to arise from a degenerative or disrupted intervertebral disc after exclusion of other important pain generators and serious pathology.

typical: Pain with sitting/flexion in some patients

investigations.principle: MRI may show degeneration or annular changes but imaging alone cannot prove the pain source.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Discography and invasive procedures are highly selective and should not be routine.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kati-shoola/Vata phenotype may be documented only as a parallel assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Axial low-back pain suspected to arise from a degenerative or disrupted intervertebral disc after exclusion of other important pain generators and serious pathology.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
